_readme: atoms.accel.com/portfolio-old, extracted 2026-08-31 via the browser pane (escalation ladder step 3): Finsweet cmsload pagination is JS-only and the CDN strips the ?fd77e97b_page param for direct fetches, so the page was driven in-browser and all 39 cards read from the DOM. Cohort year rides each card; the program FAQ states Atoms invests $1M-2M (equity or convertible note) in selected startups — decisions.md ruling #4 (in where Accel money deployed). One AtomsX company is in stealth and unlisted.
